description: $0.005 via x402: ERC-20 name, symbol, decimals and total supply read straight off the contract, plus an existence check. Because it reads the contract and not an indexer it answers for tokens minted MINUTES ago and on chains no explorer covers — the gap that makes indexer-backed lookups return nothing for a fresh launch. Legacy bytes32 name/symbol decoded; a missing decimals() is flagged, not silently assumed. The first read to make on an unknown contract.

x_payment.description: signed x402 payment payload (the X-PAYMENT header value) for the terms the first call returns; omit it to get the price and terms
